_doc: angle2pnw-faithful2 on-road tuning overlay reference. Every 'value' below is Alan Polk's exact bp-7.0 default (F-150 Lightning / CAN-FD body-on-frame gain pair). Delete a key (or the whole file) to fall back to that default. Deploy target: /data/pnw/angle_tuning.json. Only these tuning-relevant knobs are read from this file -- structural/safety constants (soft ROC table, DBC path_angle range, PSCM unwind rate, stall-blip timing, curvature deviation clip, PSCM d_ref table) are NOT tunable here; they are mirrored in panda's ford.h and changing them from Python alone would desync the safety backstop. See opendbc/car/ford/angle_tuning_pnw.py and drives/2026-07-18/lightning-angle-steering/ALAN-POLK-PORT-DEVIATIONS.md.

gain_lowC_highV._doc: path_angle gain, low-curvature/high-speed dampening (unitless). bp-7.0 _GAIN_CANFD_BOF[0] -- CAN-FD body-on-frame trucks (F-150/Lightning/Expedition/Ranger). Sane range 0.5-1.5.

gain_highC_highV._doc: path_angle gain, high-curvature/high-speed (unitless). bp-7.0 _GAIN_CANFD_BOF[1]. Sane range 0.5-1.5.

low_speed_curv_factor._doc: BluePilot 'Low Speed Factor' user knob (unitless, scales response below ~30 mph). bp-7.0 default 1.0. Range 0.5-1.5 (Alan Polk's own UI clip).

high_speed_curv_factor._doc: BluePilot 'High Speed Factor' user knob (unitless, scales response above ~70 mph). bp-7.0 default 1.0. Range 0.5-1.5.

lane_change_factor_high_ang._doc: Angle-mode lane-change steering authority multiplier (unitless). bp-7.0 default 1.0. Range 0.85-1.50 (Alan Polk's own UI clip).

path_angle_blend_ratio._doc: Predicted-curvature blend weight b (0=planner-desired only, 1=model-predicted only). bp-7.0 _FORD_PATH_ANGLE_BLEND_RATIO_DEFAULT. Range 0.0-1.0.

vlt_extra_max._doc: Max extra Variable-Lookup-Time lookahead above t_base (seconds). bp-7.0 _VLT_T_EXTRA_MAX. Range 0.0-0.5.

gain_speed_lo_ms._doc: Low-speed breakpoint for the path_angle gain interp (m/s). 6.7056 = 15 mph. AUTHOR-CONFIRMED 2026-07-19: Alan Polk confirmed the intended anchors are 15/70 mph and that bp-7.0's shipped 13.5/26.82 (30/60 mph) 'is not enough'. Range 0-50; must stay below gain_speed_hi_ms.

gain_speed_hi_ms._doc: High-speed breakpoint for the path_angle gain interp (m/s). 31.2928 = 70 mph. AUTHOR-CONFIRMED 2026-07-19 (bp-7.0 ships 26.82 = 60 mph). Range 0-50; must stay above gain_speed_lo_ms.

low_speed_boost._doc: Fixed low-speed-curvature boost multiplier, bp-7.0 line 446 (`1.30 * self.low_speed_curv_factor`). Range 1.0-2.0.

curvature_factor_bp_lo._doc: Lower curvature (1/m) breakpoint for the gain-boost interpolation, bp-7.0 line 449. Range 0.0001-0.01; must stay below curvature_factor_bp_hi or both revert to default.

curvature_factor_bp_hi._doc: Upper curvature (1/m) breakpoint for the gain-boost interpolation, bp-7.0 line 449. Range 0.0001-0.01; must stay above curvature_factor_bp_lo or both revert to default.
